name: com.didtheyopen/mcp
title: Did They Open
description: Open tracking for the email your agent already sends from your Gmail or Outlook.

tools.name: didtheyopen_signup
tools.description: Create a didtheyopen account (no email needed). Use only when no agent key is set for this server (Authorization header). Returns an agent key for this server and a dashboard login for the owner, shown once.

tools.name: didtheyopen_track_email
tools.description: Get a tracking pixel for ONE email the owner asked to track. Returns an tag to put at the end of the HTML body before sending, and, given the links of the email (pass them by default), a tracked address for each link. Never use for plain-text emails or sensitive correspondence. After sending, keep watching with didtheyopen_new_opens on a schedule and tell the owner when it is opened, without waiting to be asked.

client_ref.description: Your own unique id for this email, e.g. "proposal-dana-2026-11-10". Reuse it on retries.

label.description: Recipient display name shown in the owner dashboard, e.g. "Dana Levi". Never an email address.

sender_label.description: Which mailbox it was sent from. Default work.

links.description: The link addresses (href) in the HTML body; pass them by default whenever the email has links. Returns a tracked address for each, so a click by the recipient also counts as opened, even in Apple Mail, which hides opens. Leave out only when the owner says not to track links. Unsubscribe, mailto and non-web links are never tracked.

tools.name: didtheyopen_check_email
tools.description: Opens so far for one tracked email: count, last time, and each open with device family.

tools.name: didtheyopen_new_opens
tools.description: What changed since a cursor, summarised per email, each open exactly once. Meant to run without the owner asking, as one permanent recurring job every 10 to 15 minutes: it says which emails are worth telling the owner about right now (first open, a new device, a return after a pause) and which are noise. First call (or after losing the cursor): since = an ISO time such as when tracking started or just before your last check. Then pass back the returned cursor and keep it in durable notes.

since.description: ISO-8601 time or the cursor returned by the previous call.

tools.name: didtheyopen_account
tools.description: Plan, trial emails left, whether new emails can be tracked, today usage, and upgrade links.
